description: The Public Service Commission - Rules for the Procedure and Quorum of Committees made by the Public Service Commission under Article 56(3) of Constitution
categorisation: This gazette contains rules and procedures issued by the Public Service Commission regarding the operation of its committees, including meeting procedures, quorum requirements, and record-keeping. It specifically deals with public service administration and governance matters, falling under the "Public Service Gazettes" category (Type 8) which covers public service recruitment, service conditions, administrative circulars, and commission procedures.
